component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.documents.marks
component.documentation:
Export-control marks, since 0.3.0. A controlled document's mark, the export_mark schema of the ControlledDocument facet, prefix docmark, is a classification and the groups that may receive the revision.
ChangeExportMark: the add-on's permission. Setting, changing and removing a revision's mark needs it on the revision, or, for a new one, on its folder; the controlled document listener checks it, writes who and when, and fires one audit entry per change, exportMarkChanged, which the writer below adds to the platform's audit once its transaction has committed. Nuxeo counts Everything as holding every permission, and administrators as holding them all.
The download permission: the platform's DownloadService asks every permission before it streams a blob or a rendition, and refuses it with 403 when one returns false. This one refuses a marked revision's files and renditions to anyone in none of its mark's groups, an administrator included, and a container's renditions, but its thumbnail, when it holds a marked revision. The script only hands its globals to ExportMarkDownloadPermission, which decides in Java; should the class not load, the script answers false, so a broken install refuses downloads rather than serving them.
The exportMark document enricher says why: the mark, and whether the reader may receive it, with a reason code a client translates. It explains; the permission refuses.
